How is a profiteer made (How is a profiteer made (page 22)) It must be worth 2,000 source crystals no matter what." Lynch stretched out his hand with a serious look on his face. "Now, please pay!" Earl Lowe's mouth twitched. , his heart ached with anger. He didn't expect Lin Qi to be so shameless and greedy. However, due to the current situation, one was Dao Zu and the other was Yurou. No matter how unhappy he was, he could only listen to Lin Qi's words. Luo Wei bent down and took out another Source Crystal card from the sole of his boot. His face was terrifyingly gloomy. "Here are 20,000 Source Crystals. Capture that little bitch Yulia alive for me. I will deal with her myself!" Lin Qi frowned. , staring at the Source Crystal card with some disgust. However, when he heard that there were 20,000 Source Crystals in it, Lin Qi became determined again. "The Source Crystals are not guilty, they just stink." He reached out and took it, and there were indeed 20,000 Source Crystals in it. A source crystal. Lin Qi put away the source crystal card and stared at Count Luo Wei. "I just said that all the source crystal cards on your body are my spoils. What you have to pay me cannot be the source crystal on your body." "What did you say?!" Count Luo Wei's eyes widened with shock. Then he became furious: "Are you kidding me?!" Lin Qi looked disgusted and almost vomited out. "Count, don't say such disgusting words. I'm not interested in you." Count Luo Wei was so angry that he was shaking. "The source crystal card on my body is your trophy, so no matter how many source crystals I give you, won't it be useless?" "Aren't you playing with me? What is this?!" Facing Luo Wei's anger, Lin Qi showed a professional smile. "So, you have no money?" As he spoke, he raised the dragon fire hammer. But Luo Wei felt a wave of fire. Chills rose from the soles of his feet. "You have to give me more than 40,000 source crystals!" Count Luo Wei was so scared that he backed away, his voice full of grievance and despair. Lin Qi stepped closer, his smile unchanged, his eyes clear and serious. "I said, everything on you is my trophy, and you are also my mission. If you can take out the 20,000 source crystals that are not yours, I can take on a new mission. Yulia was tied to your grave. "But if you can't get the source crystal, then I have nothing to talk about." At this moment, Luo Wei completely realized that Lin Qi had been playing with him, and he couldn't survive even if he gave him more source crystals. "Bingo! You are right." "You are already on the death list, how can you survive?" Approaching Count Luo Wei. The chill of death enveloped his whole body. Luo Wei's legs weakened and he collapsed in a pool of blood. He crouched back and ran away. "Don't kill me! I still have a lot of minerals. If you don't kill me, I can give you everything in my territory." Lynch shook his head slowly: "I don't want minerals, I only collect source crystals." "Last chance. If you have treasures buried in other places, tell me now, and I can go and verify them. "If it is true, I can take over the task before your death." "No, you can't do this! You can't do this!" He roared, picked up the things beside him and threw them at Lin Qi. "It seems that there is really no more..." Lin Qi shook his head in disappointment, and raised the dragon fire hammer in his hand. The flames reflected Luo Wei's frightened face. "Boom."
